column1: # ARM DDI 0487 C4.1.95.8 / C4.1.95.9 Advanced SIMD scalar shift by immediate: (word & 0xdf800400) == 0x5f000400.
# Slice U=0 (1/2): enumerates all 16 x 8 x 32 = 4,096 non-register combinations
# of immh=0..15 (including immh=0 unallocated counterexamples), immb=0..7, opcode=0..31 (bit[23]=0, bit[10]=1)
# with fixed distinct scalar registers Rd=1, Rn=2 (excludes bit[10]=0 Group 26 AdvSIMD scalar indexed element).
# Across advsimd_scalar_shift_imm_u0 and u1 (2 x 4,096 = 8,192 rows), every Group 30 non-register encoding is covered.
# Reference tool version: Apple LLVM version 21.0.0
# Assembly command: xcrun clang -arch arm64e advsimd_scalar_shift_imm_u0.s -o advsimd_scalar_shift_imm_u0.macho
